title: Allowance Cut on Delay Credits for Ridgeline Special Order Services Orders Carrying Damage Allowances
content:
Damage allowances already credited on a Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program whose deposit at order is 50 percent reduce the rate at which a delay credit on that order is figured, through the allowance cut.

**Clause.** The allowance cut depends on the damage allowances credited on the order: allowances totalling at least 20 percent of the order total billed give an allowance cut of 1; allowances totalling less than that but above 0.00 give 0.5; otherwise the cut is 0.

The allowance cut is a number of percentage points taken off the percentage of the credit base at which the delay credit is figured.

## Records read

The damage allowance credit lines on the order, added together, and the order total billed on its order billing line.

## Cut by allowances credited (hypothetical order total billed 3200.00, so 20 percent is 640.00)

| Damage allowances credited on the order | Share of the order total billed | Allowance cut (points) |
|---|---|---|
| 800.00 | 25 percent | 1 |
| 640.00 | 20 percent | 1 |
| 480.00 | 15 percent | 0.5 |
| 0.00 | none | 0 |

An order with no damage allowance credit line carries no cut.
